text:
Maya: Quick sync — can we land a single hero that works for Hosted / Dedicated / Private without sounding vague?
Kevin: Yeah we need clarity + gating for enterprise buyers. one-line value + 2 bullets for mode differences.
Sarah: Agreed. Prefer: 1) Developer-first API 2) Production economics 3) Deployment choices. short hero, then tabs for Hosted | Dedicated | Private.
Tom: I’ll mock a three-state hero with small microcopy for each tab. want variants: ‘fastest to ship’, ‘predictable throughput’, ‘private & compliant’.
Maya: Nice — draft headlines below, vote quick: 
- Headline A: "Inference that scales with your product, not your ops"
- Headline B: "Ship LLM features — hosted, dedicated, or private"
- Headline C: "Predictable LLM inference across any environment"
Kevin: I like C + subhead that calls out latency & cost.
Sarah: Can we include a benchmark CTA: 'See 99th-pt latency and per-token cost for common workloads'? link to benchmark page.
Maya: Good call — for the benchmark narrative, recommend: 1) quick summary stat (e.g., "<30ms tail latency on small conv models"), 2) cost delta chart vs naive self-hosting, 3) a one-click bench report per model.
copybot: Suggested microcopy for tab content:
Hosted: "Start with our hosted API — instant keys, streaming, usage analytics."
Dedicated: "Reserved GPU pools and SLA-backed throughput for production traffic."
Private: "VPC/on-prem with customer-managed keys and audit logs."
Maya: Love it. Keep bullets to 2-3 lines max.
Kevin: Webinar hook — run a live session titled 'From Prototype to Production: Serving LLMs at Scale'. Include a short demo of moving the same app across hosted -> dedicated -> private.
Sarah: For inbound lead routing, proposed rules:
- trials + usage > 100k tokens/month -> sales-assist for Dedicated
- enterprise domains (gov, finance) -> private deployment AE assignment
- webinar signups -> product-marketing nurture flow
Tom: Can we add a small visual (decision flow) next to pricing table?
Maya: Yes. Also need copy for CTAs per mode:
- Hosted: 'Try hosted — get API key'
- Dedicated: 'Request reserved capacity'
- Private: 'Talk to sales about private deployments'
Kevin: Routing config snippet for engineering intake (example):
```
route:
  if usage.tokens > 100000: assign: dedicated-sales
  if email_domain in enterprise_domains: assign: private-ae
  if signup.source == webinar: assign: pm-nurture
```
Sarah: That snippet is perfect for the handoff doc. Ops can convert to the CRM rules.
Maya: Timeline: copy pass by EOD Wednesday, design comps Thursday, bench page content + charts by next Monday, webinar landing by Tue.
Tom: I'll prototype hero states tonight and ping for quick review.
Kevin: I'll draft the benchmark callouts and the webinar outline.
Sarah: I'll wire the lead routing matrix and update the nurture flows doc.
Maya: Great — final ask: keep language developer-focused, but add an enterprise-ready line in the hero subhead.
copybot: Micro-CTA alternatives: ["Get API key (Hosted)", "Reserve capacity (Dedicated)", "Request private deployment (Private)"]
Maya: Thanks all — leaving comments in the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/landing-copy-iteration (feel free to edit). :rocket:
